preconditions.description: The length of string s is between 1 and 100,000.
The string s has exactly n characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in s is a lowercase Latin alphabet character.

postconditions.description: The output string t has the same length as the input string s.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
postconditions.description: Each character in t is a lowercase Latin alphabet character.

postconditions.expression: all(t.count(c) == s.count(c) for c in set(s))
postconditions.description: Each character in t appears the same number of times as it does in s.
The palindromic count of t is at least as large as the palindromic count of s.

postconditions.expression: exists(max_palindromic_count(t) == max_palindromic_count(u) for all u with the same character counts as t)
postconditions.description: There is no other string with the same character counts that has a larger palindromic count than t.
